goal: Launcher picks the newest Python 3.11-3.13 and fails cleanly when there is none (Board gate 171: accept 3.11-3.13 only, 3.14 rejected; message 'DataBoot needs Python 3.12. Install it with: winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.12', pause, exit 1)

acceptance_criteria.text: Start-DataBoot.ps1 defines `function Fail($Message)` that does Write-Host $Message, then `if (Test-Path .venv) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .venv }`, then Read-Host (to pause), then `exit 1`, in that order
One line `$Candidates = @(@("py", "-3.13"), @("py", "-3.12"), @("py", "-3.11"), @("python"))` holds the versions in that order; the script has no literal `py -3.1x -m venv` line

The script holds `$Check` = `import sys; sys.exit(0 if (3, 11) <= sys.version_info[:2] <= (3, 13) else 1)`; a loop skips a candidate when Get-Command (with -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) finds nothing, runs the check on every candidate including py ones (so 3.14 is rejected), with `$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"` set locally and restored (or try/catch) so py's stderr 'No suitable Python runtime' does not throw in Windows PowerShell 5.1; the first candidate with $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 is used

The venv is created with `& $py[0] @rest -m venv .venv` on the chosen candidate; when none matches the script calls `Fail "DataBoot needs Python 3.12. Install it with: winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.12"` (exact text)
The folder dialog, folder check, -Docker branch, wheels install and final `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.launch $Folder` lines are unchanged

tests/test_launcher_files.py: replace the needle "py -3.11" with "-3.11" (every other needle stays) and add text tests: -3.13, -3.12, -3.11 appear in that order inside the `$Candidates` line followed by "python"; the script contains `(3, 11) <= sys.version_info[:2] <= (3, 13)`; `re.search(r"py -3\.1\d+ -m venv", ps1)` does not match; the exact no-Python message is present; `function Fail` holds Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .venv, Read-Host and exit 1 in that order
There is no PowerShell in the image, so the tests are text checks only; the Board runs the script on Windows with 3.12 + 3.14 and with no suitable Python
Moves acceptance items AC-28, AC-30 forward
